name: Planar Hunter
body:
Planar Hunter (Su)
Source Monster Summoner's Handbook pg. 9
Whenever the magus enhances his weapon using his arcane pool, he can spend 1 additional point from his arcane pool to add the planarUE special ability to his weapon, or 2 additional points to add the phase lockingUE special ability. The magus must be at least 9th level before selecting this arcana.
